questions.q: Put the five P2P stages in the correct order.
options: Invoice, requisition, receipt, purchase order, payment
Purchase order, requisition, invoice, receipt, payment
Requisition, purchase order, receipt, invoice, payment and posting
Payment, receipt, requisition, purchase order, invoice
questions.explain: The chain runs requisition, then purchase order, then receipt, then invoice, then payment and posting to the ledger.

questions.q: Which chapter covers change orders and closing/cancelling the purchase order?
options: Chapter 2 — Requisitions
Chapter 3 — Purchase Orders
Chapter 4 — Receiving
Chapter 5 — Invoice to Ledger
questions.explain: Chapter 3 covers creating, approving, changing, and closing/cancelling the purchase order using this course's example PO.

questions.q: What is the best way to describe the difference between a module and a work area?
options: They are exactly the same thing with different names
A module is a type of purchase order
A work area is only used for reporting, never for transactions
A module is how Oracle organizes functionality and security behind the scenes; a work area is the landing page scoped to a specific role's tasks
questions.explain: Modules organize functionality and security; work areas are the task-scoped landing pages built on top of them for each role.

questions.q: What does a requisition line's distribution determine?
options: Which cost center, project, or account the purchase should be charged to
The supplier's remittance bank account
The receiving clerk's name
The payment terms on the eventual invoice
questions.explain: The distribution on a requisition line is where the accounting - which cost center or project absorbs the cost - is determined.

questions.q: Does an approved requisition automatically become a purchase order?
options: Yes, approval and purchase order creation happen in the same step
No, it lands in a buyer's Process Requisitions worklist and must be processed into a purchase order
No, it is automatically cancelled once approved
Yes, but only for non-catalog requests
questions.explain: Approval alone does not create a purchase order - the requisition line moves to a buyer's worklist for processing.

questions.q: What determines who must approve a given requisition in Oracle Fusion Cloud?
options: A single hard-coded approver for the entire company
The requisition number, in numerical order
Whichever employee is logged in first that day
Configurable approval rules that can consider amount, item category, business unit, and the requester's supervisory hierarchy
questions.explain: Approvals are driven by configurable rules evaluated against factors like amount, category, BU, and hierarchy, not a single fixed approver.

questions.q: Which two document types are both categorized as "supplier agreements" (long-term arrangements)?
options: Blanket purchase agreement and contract purchase agreement
Standard purchase order and requisition
Receipt and invoice
Change order and close order
questions.explain: Blanket purchase agreements and contract purchase agreements are both classified as supplier agreements, distinct from the one-time standard purchase order.

questions.q: What does a purchase order status of "Open" mean?
options: The purchase order is still in draft and has not been submitted
The purchase order has been approved and is now available for receiving and invoicing
The purchase order has been paid in full
The purchase order has been cancelled
questions.explain: Open status indicates the PO is approved and ready for receiving and invoicing activity - only then is it something the supplier can act on.

questions.q: What does "Closed for Receiving" mean for a purchase order?
options: The purchase order has been cancelled entirely
No invoicing has happened yet
No further receiving activity is expected, though invoicing may still occur
The purchase order was rejected during approval
questions.explain: Closed for Receiving specifically means receiving activity is done, while invoicing (such as a final invoice) might still be outstanding.

questions.q: Why does LTV Manufacturing route the PB-4400 bearing through inspection required instead of direct delivery?
options: Because inspection is mandatory for every item in Oracle Fusion Cloud
Because a defective bearing in a production line motor risks costly downtime or equipment damage, making inspection worthwhile relative to its cost
Because Meridian Bearing Supply Co. requires it contractually for all customers
Because the bearing is a service item rather than a goods item
questions.explain: Routing is a risk-based decision configured per item: a critical mechanical part like this bearing justifies the cost of inspection given what a defect could cause.

questions.q: Why would an unprocessed return or correction cause a problem when Meridian's invoice arrives?
options: If the received quantity available for matching is lower than the invoiced quantity, the invoice will not match within tolerance and will be placed on hold
It would have no effect on invoice processing at all
It would automatically cancel the purchase order
It would double the amount owed to the supplier
questions.explain: A mismatch between received and invoiced quantity, caused by an unprocessed return or correction, can trigger a matching hold rather than allowing payment.

questions.q: What happens to the uninvoiced receipts accrual account once Chen matches and accounts Meridian's invoice?
options: The invoice accounting debits this same accrual account and credits accounts payable, clearing the accrual
It is permanently ignored and never touched again
It doubles in value to reflect both the receipt and the invoice
It converts directly into cash paid to the supplier
questions.explain: The invoice's accounting clears the accrual by debiting it and crediting accounts payable, replacing the generic accrual with a liability to a specific supplier invoice.

questions.q: What produces the third and final journal in this transaction's accounting?
options: The actual cash payment disbursed through the Payment Process Request, debiting accounts payable and crediting cash
Dana submitting her original requisition
Priya's receipt being created
Marcus approving the purchase order
questions.explain: The payment itself produces the final journal, clearing the accounts payable liability by debiting it and crediting cash.

questions.q: Why is LTV's bearing purchase order set to require 3-way matching rather than 2-way?
options: Because 3-way matching is required for every purchase order regardless of item type
Because physical delivery confirmation matters for a mechanical part, making it important to verify goods were actually received before paying
Because Meridian Bearing Supply Co. refuses to accept 2-way matching
Because the purchase order amount exceeds a certain dollar threshold
questions.explain: The match approval level was set considering that physical delivery confirmation is important for this kind of item, making 3-way matching the appropriate control.

questions.q: What are common causes of an AP trial balance to GL mismatch?
options: A transaction accounted in Payables but not yet transferred to GL, a manual journal that bypassed the subledger, or a period-close timing difference
The supplier changing their remittance address
A requisition being submitted by the wrong requester
A purchase order being communicated by email instead of the Supplier Portal
questions.explain: Typical causes include untransferred subledger accounting, manual GL journals bypassing the subledger, or timing differences around period close.

questions.q: What kind of matching does Chen perform against Meridian's invoice in this walkthrough?
options: 2-way matching, against the purchase order only
4-way matching, against a separate acceptance document
3-way matching, against both the purchase order and the receipt
No matching is performed at all
questions.explain: The purchase order was set to require 3-way matching, checking the invoice against both the purchase order and Priya's receipt.

questions.q: In the price variance exception, why can't Chen simply pay the invoice billed 8% above the purchase order price?
options: Because Oracle Fusion Cloud does not allow any price above the original requisition estimate
Because it falls outside the configured price tolerance, failing 3-way matching and creating a matching hold that must be resolved first
Because Meridian Bearing Supply Co. is not a registered supplier
Because the purchase order was never approved
questions.explain: An 8% price variance outside tolerance fails matching and creates a hold, blocking payment until the discrepancy is resolved with the supplier.
